Klasse GenericStack<T>

java.lang.Object
GenericStack<T>
Typparameter:

    • push

      public void push(T element) throws StackFullException
      Pushes a new top element onto the stack.
      Parameter:
      element - the element which should be pushed to the top of the stack.
      Löst aus:
      StackFullException - if the stack is already full of elements.

    • pop

      public T pop() throws StackEmptyException
      Removes and returns the top. element of the stack
      Gibt zurück:
      the removed element. (which was at the top)
      Löst aus:
      StackEmptyException - if the stack is empty. (has no more elements in it)

    • peek

      public T peek() throws StackEmptyException
      Returns the top element of the stack. (doesn't remove it)
      Gibt zurück:
      the top element of the stack.
      Löst aus:
      StackEmptyException - if the stack is empty. (has elements in it)
